page_title: MON 3-2 MAR | Monaco v Marseille 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+2' Substitution. Denis Zakaria makes way for Mohamed Camara (Monaco).
90+1' Vitinha (Marseille) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
90+1' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) passes the ball onto Vanderson, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
89' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
87' The Monaco players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
85' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call. Monaco are awarded the free kick.
83' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vitinha (Marseille) replacing Azzedine Ounahi.
83' Substitution. Myron Boadu (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Folarin Balogun walks off.
79' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) swings it in and Folarin Balogun gets on the end of it, but Pau Lopez shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
77' Yellow card. Valentin Rongier (Marseille) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
77' Eliot Matazo (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' The ball possession is 46:54.
75' Substitution. Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) replaces Joaquin Correa.
75' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Ismail Jakobs will be replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Eliot Matazo (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Maghnes Akliouche.
73' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
71' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
71' PENALTY APPEAL by Marseille, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
70' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' Marseille are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
64' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save! Monaco have a corner.
63' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
59' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
59' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
57' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
56' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
56' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
54' What was Joaquin Correa (Marseille) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

52' 3 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Folarin Balogun, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who beats Pau Lopez with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:2.
50' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
50' The corner kick from Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
48' Iliman Ndiaye has picked up an injury and is replaced by Amine Harit (Marseille).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
43' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
40' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
39' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul. Marseille are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
35' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Vanderson (Monaco) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Pau Lopez was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

34' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monaco are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
30' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
29' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Vanderson (Monaco).

29' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Monaco.
28' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
25' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
25' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom left corner. Pau Lopez is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
23' 2 - 2 Goal! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
22' The ball is cleared after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' 1 - 2 Goal! Iliman Ndiaye puts a cross into the box and finds Samuel Gigot (Marseille), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
17' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
15' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
11' Folarin Balogun provides the assist in the box, but Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
8' 1 - 1 Goal! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
8' A cross from Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

6' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful shot from the edge of the box, low towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and easily denies him.
5' Wonderful movement by Marseille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

1' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang. The score is now 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will referee today's match.
